description: CO2 levels rose sharply overnight on the upper floor every night during simulation, raising concerns about crew safety and cognitive performance.
response: A 6-inch fan was installed through the emergency exit, pulling fresh air from the lower hab, with internal hab doors left open. CO2 dropped to half its previous levels.
lesson: CO2 monitoring must begin on Day 1, before the first night. Have a ventilation solution pre-planned — the fan-through-emergency-exit approach is proven and should be standard operating procedure from night 1.
